title: Order VIII Rule 1 CPC — Written statement

content.overview: The written statement is due in thirty days, extendable with recorded reasons up to ninety days in ordinary suits.
content.study: Commercial Courts treat the outer limit as stricter. Late WS is not automatic death in every ordinary suit — check the current Supreme Court reading before you shut the defendant out.
